title: Wizards and Roads
statementMd:
In some country live wizards. They love to build cities and roads.

The country used to have $*k*$ cities, the $*j*$-th city ($1 ≤ *j* ≤ *k*$) was located at a point ($*x*_{*j*}$, $*y*_{*j*}$). It was decided to create another $*n* - *k*$ cities. And the $*i*$-th one ($*k* < *i* ≤ *n*$) was created at a point with coordinates ($*x*_{*i*}$, $*y*_{*i*}$):

- $*x*_{*i*} = (*a*·*x*_{*i* - 1} + *b*) *mod* (10^{9} + 9)$
- $*y*_{*i*} = (*c*·*y*_{*i* - 1} + *d*) *mod* (10^{9} + 9)$

Here $*a*$, $*b*$, $*c*$, $*d*$ are primes. Also, $*a* ≠ *c*, *b* ≠ *d*$.

After the construction of all $*n*$ cities, the wizards have noticed something surprising. It turned out that for every two different cities $*i*$ and $*j*$, $*x*_{*i*} ≠ *x*_{*j*}$ and $*y*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*j*}$ holds.

The cities are built, it's time to build roads! It was decided to use the most difficult (and, of course, the most powerful) spell for the construction of roads. Using this spell creates a road between the towns of $*u*$, $*v*$ ($*y*_{*u*}$ > $*y*_{*v*}$) if and only if for any city $*w*$ which lies strictly inside the corner at the point $*u*$, $*v*$ (see below), there is a city $*s*$ that does not lie in the corner, which is located along the $*x*$-coordinate strictly between $*w*$ and $*u*$ and simultaneously $*y*_{*s*} > *y*_{*v*}$.

A *corner* on the points $*p*_{2}$($*x*_{2}$, $*y*_{2}$), $*p*_{1}$($*x*_{1}$, $*y*_{1}$) ($*y*_{1} < *y*_{2}$) is the set of points ($*x*, *y*$), for which at least one of the two conditions is fulfilled:

- $*min*(*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}) ≤ *x* ≤ *max*(*x*_{1}, *x*_{2})$ and $*y* ≥ *y*_{1}$
- $*y*_{1} ≤ *y* ≤ *y*_{2}$ and $(*x* - *x*_{2})·(*x*_{1} - *x*_{2}) ≥ 0$

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46711a4199ab47f454e9b4e2c18c0ef5a8c6d436.png) The pictures showing two different corners

In order to test the spell, the wizards will apply it to all the cities that lie on the $*x*$-coordinate in the interval $[*L*, *R*]$. After the construction of roads the national government wants to choose the maximum number of pairs of cities connected by the road, so that no city occurs in two or more pairs. Your task is for each $*m*$ offered variants of values $*L*$, $*R*$ to calculate the maximum number of such pairs after the construction of the roads. Please note that the cities that do not lie in the interval $[*L*, *R*]$ on the $*x*$-coordinate, do not affect the construction of roads in any way.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$, $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $*k* ≤ 30$). Next $*k*$ lines contain coordinates of the cities' location points from the first to the $*k*$-th one. The $*j*$-th line contains space-separated pair of integers $*x*_{*j*}$, $*y*_{*j*}$ ($0 ≤ *x*_{*j*}, *y*_{*j*} < 10^{9} + 9$) — coordinates of the $*j*$-th city.

The next line contains space-separated integers $*a*, *b*, *c*, *d*$ ($2 ≤ *a*, *b*, *c*, *d* < 10^{9} + 9$). It is guaranteed that those numbers are prime and also that $*a* ≠ *c*, *b* ≠ *d*$.

It's guaranteed, that for every two different cities $*i*$ and $*j*$, $*x*_{*i*} ≠ *x*_{*j*}$ and $*y*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*j*}$ holds.

The next line contains integer $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of variants to build the roads. Next $*m*$ lines contain pairs of space-separated integers $*L*_{*i*}$, $*R*_{*i*}$ ($0 ≤ *L*_{*i*} ≤ *R*_{*i*} < 10^{9} + 9$) — the variants of choosing the cities to build the roads.

## Output

For any pair of numbers $*L*_{*i*}$, $*R*_{*i*}$ print the answer to the problem on a single line. Print the answers for the pairs in the order, in which the pairs are given in the input data.

## Note

In the first sample the roads connect the cities in a chain in the order of increasing of $*x*$.

In the second sample the remaining 5 cities will be located at points $(5,  11); (20,  263098); (65,  292514823); (200,  76958738); (605,  622120197)$.
statementZhMd:
某个国家里生活着一些巫师。他们喜欢建造城市和道路。

这个国家原本有 $*k*$ 座城市，第 $*j*$ 座城市（$1 ≤ *j* ≤ *k*$）位于点（$*x*_{*j*}$，$*y*_{*j*}$）。现在决定再建造 $*n* - *k*$ 座城市。其中第 $*i*$ 座城市（$*k* < *i* ≤ *n*$）建造在坐标为（$*x*_{*i*}$，$*y*_{*i*}$）的点上：

- $*x*_{*i*} = (*a*·*x*_{*i* - 1} + *b*) *mod* (10^{9} + 9)$
- $*y*_{*i*} = (*c*·*y*_{*i* - 1} + *d*) *mod* (10^{9} + 9)$

其中 $*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$、$*d*$ 均为质数。此外，$*a* ≠ *c*, *b* ≠ *d*$。

建造完全部 $*n*$ 座城市后，巫师们发现了一件令人惊讶的事情。对于任意两个不同的城市 $*i*$ 和 $*j*$，始终满足 $*x*_{*i*} ≠ *x*_{*j*}$ 且 $*y*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*j*}$。

城市已经建好，接下来该修建道路了！巫师们决定使用最复杂（当然也是最强大）的魔法来修建道路。如果 $*y*_{*u*}$ > $*y*_{*v*}$，使用该魔法将在城市 $*u*$ 和 $*v*$ 之间修建一条道路，当且仅当：对于位于点 $*u*$、$*v*$ 所构成的角形区域内部的任意城市 $*w*$，都存在一座不在该角形区域内的城市 $*s*$，使得 $*s*$ 的 $x$ 坐标严格位于 $*w*$ 和 $*u*$ 的 $x$ 坐标之间，并且同时满足 $*y*_{*s*} > *y*_{*v*$。

点 $*p*_{2}$($*x*_{2}$, $*y*_{2}$)、$*p*_{1}$($*x*_{1}$, $*y*_{1}$)（$*y*_{1} < *y*_{2}$）所构成的*角形区域*，是满足以下至少一个条件的点（$*x*$，$*y*$）的集合：

- $*min*(*x*_{1}, *x*_{2}) ≤ *x* ≤ *max*(*x*_{1}, *x*_{2})$ 且 $*y* ≥ *y*_{1}$
- $*y*_{1} ≤ *y* ≤ *y*_{2}$ 且 $(*x* - *x*_{2})·(*x*_{1} - *x*_{2}) ≥ 0$

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/46711a4199ab47f454e9b4e2c18c0ef5a8c6d436.png) 展示两个不同角形区域的图片

为了测试这个魔法，巫师们会对所有 $x$ 坐标位于区间 $[*L*, *R*]$ 内的城市施展它。道路建成后，国家政府希望选出数量最多的城市对，使得每一对城市之间都有道路相连，且每座城市不会出现在两个或更多城市对中。对于给出的 $*m*$ 组 $*L*$、$*R*$，你的任务是分别计算修建道路后这样的城市对的最大数量。请注意，$x$ 坐标不在区间 $[*L*, *R*]$ 内的城市不会以任何方式影响道路的修建。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$、$*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$*k* ≤ 30$）。接下来的 $*k*$ 行包含第 $1$ 座至第 $*k*$ 座城市的位置坐标。第 $*j*$ 行包含一对用空格分隔的整数 $*x*_{*j}$、$*y*_{*j}$（$0 ≤ *x*_{*j}, *y*_{*j} < 10^{9} + 9$），表示第 $*j*$ 座城市的坐标。

下一行包含四个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*$、$*b*$、$*c*$、$*d*$（$2 ≤ *a*、*b*、*c*、*d* < 10^{9} + 9$）。保证这些数均为质数，且 $*a* ≠ *c*, *b* ≠ *d*$。

保证对于任意两个不同的城市 $*i*$ 和 $*j*$，始终满足 $*x*_{*i*} ≠ *x*_{*j}$ 且 $*y*_{*i*} ≠ *y*_{*j}$。

下一行包含整数 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示修建道路的方案数量。接下来的 $*m*$ 行包含两​​个用空格分隔的整数 $*L*_{*i}$、$*R*_{*i}$（$0 ≤ *L*_{*i*} ≤ *R*_{*i*} < 10^{9} + 9$），表示选择修建道路的城市范围方案。

## 输出格式

对于每一对 $*L*_{*i}$、$*R*_{*i}$，在单独一行中输出该方案的答案。按照输入中给出这些数对的顺序输出答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，道路按照 $x$ 坐标递增的顺序将城市连接成一条链。

在第二个样例中，剩余的 5 座城市将位于以下点：$(5,  11); (20,  263098); (65,  292514823); (200,  76958738); (605,  622120197)$。
